content.title: Where to watch Michigan State vs. Louisville March Madness matchup for free today
content.text: Updated: Mar. 21, 2026, 12:40 p.m.Published: Mar. 21, 2026, 12:40 p.m.Michigan State Spartans guard Jeremy Fears Jr. (1) moves the ball as Michigan State faces North Dakota State in the first round of the NCAA basketball tournament in Buffalo, New York on Thursday, March 19 2026.Jacob Hamilton | MLive.comIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Jenna Malinowski | JMalinowski@mlive.comThe No. 3 Michigan State Spartans will take on the No. 6 Louisville Cardinals in the second round of the NCAA Tournament this afternoon. Fans can catch the action on CBS at 2:45 p.m. ET, with streaming options available through Fubo, DirecTV Stream and Paramount+. CBS March Madness Streaming OptionsTable not scrollableFubo: Fubo plans start at $73.99 per month and include access to CBS and other local channels such as ABC and Fox but do not include TNT, TruTV or TBS. Free trials are available for new customers, and they can also take $25 off the first month of their subscription.DirecTV Stream: DirecTV Stream’s Pro plan comes with CBS for $94.99 per month. New subscribers can start with a five-day free trial and take $35 off their first month. This plan also comes with TNT, TruTV and TBS. Paramount+: Paramount+ is currently offering a deal where new and returning customers can get any plan for just $2.99 a month for their first two months. Premium plans regularly start at $13.99 per month and include access to the CBS live broadcast.
